description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseConfigController class, which extends an abstract installer controller to manage the database configuration step within the installer workflow for the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for setting up the respective view component and managing application state for the installer.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the database configuration screen during the installation process, including setting up the view component and updating installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view for rendering by setting up the database configuration component and updating the current installation step in the state container.
